parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh and ors.

summary: Quashing of U.P. Gangsters Act FIR; predicate offences must be anti-social in nature; purely property disputes don't qualify; FIR based on civil disputes quashed; gang activity requires public interest impact; multiple related civil cases cannot form basis; prior criminal acquittal irrelevant to quashing; impugned HCoA dismissal; quashing appropriate at prima facie stage; gang chart not conclusive.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.395, s.427, s.506, s.420, s.406, s.120B
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned High Court judgment quashing FIR set aside; quashing granted on grounds of civil dispute mischaracterized as anti-social activity; appellants entitled to no prosecution under Act for predicate civil cases.
